implication: The Regulation 31(4)–(5) disclosure regime requires acquirers crossing the 25% threshold to make public disclosure within two trading days; this filing initiates the takeover clock and potential open-offer obligation, requiring counsel to verify trigger thresholds, exemptions (e.g., preferential issue, inter-se transfer), and the target's board response under Schedule III.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulations 31(4) and 31(5)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure of substantial acquisition; Reg 31(4) covers acquisition of shares/voting rights crossing materiality threshold; Reg 31(5) requires public announcement within 2 trading days.
If acquirer crosses 25% threshold, mandatory open offer to public shareholders at floor price = highest price paid in prior 6 months.
Review exemptions: inter-se transfer between persons acting in concert, preferential issue by company, rights issue, stock splits, bonus, inheritance.
Regulation 31 covers acquisition by acquirer 'along with associates'; verify concert party status under Companies Act definition.

framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011, Schedule III (target company obligations)
framework.note: Target board must convene meeting within 2 trading days of disclosure; advise acquirer's intent and shareholders' rights; engage merchant banker and legal counsel.

framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011, Regulation 13 (timing of open offer)
framework.note: Open offer must be commenced within 60 days from date of disclosure of substantial acquisition.

framework.ref: Prevention of Fraudulent and Unfair Trade Practices (PFUPs) Regulations, 2003

headline: Ganesh Sambasivam files substantial acquisition disclosure in Anthem Biosciences under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Ganesh Sambasivam submitted a SEBI Regulation 31(4) & 31(5) disclosure to NSE regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Anthem Biosciences Limited. The filing signals a takeover or material stake acquisition triggering mandatory disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011.
detail: Ganesh Sambasivam has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulations 31(4) and 31(5), with the National Stock Exchange. This disclosure is mandatory when an acquirer, either alone or in concert with associates, has purchased shares and/or voting rights such that the aggregate holding crosses the 25% threshold (or such other specified slab) in a listed company. The filing marks the public announcement of the acquisition and triggers a 60-day open-offer period (if applicable) during which the acquirer must make a public offer to acquire shares from public shareholders at a price not less than the highest price paid in the preceding 6 months.
